note.note:
Please provide:
- The full transcript of the patient encounter
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON

Once I have both, I will generate the structured "Problem List Clinical Note" with the exact headings and the required sections:
- Consult Summary
- Problem List (Issue 1, Issue 2, Issue 3)
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks

I will extract only information documented in the transcript or DDx, align differential diagnoses with the transcript when appropriate (and note any conflicts), and avoid any invented data.
